name: Physiotherapy for posture

lead: A licensed physiotherapist prescribes exercises and manual therapy to change habits like forward head posture.
Physical therapy is established for many musculoskeletal problems, but little evidence addresses posture for appearance.

paras: Strengthening of weak muscles, stretching of tight ones, mobilization and ergonomic changes.
Generally low risk when delivered by licensed practitioners; cost and effort are the main community complaints.

lead: Physiotherapy for posture refers to supervised exercise, manual therapy and education from a licensed physical therapist aimed at changing habitual alignment such as forward head posture or rounded shoulders [1][2]. Physical therapy is a regulated healthcare profession that treats movement limitations, with exercise as a core tool [1].

Evidence that physical therapy improves pain and function in many musculoskeletal conditions is described in encyclopedias [1]. Wikipedia also states there is little strong evidence that any particular posture leads to better medical outcomes [3].
infobox: Forward head posture, rounded shoulders, kyphosis
Licensed (e.g. DPT in US, HCPC in UK)

paras: Programs commonly strengthen the mid and lower back, scapular retractors and deep neck flexors, stretch muscles that pull the head forward, and add thoracic mobilization and ergonomic changes, according to Wikipedia's forward head posture article, which flags parts of its content as lacking reliable references [2]. Specialist schools such as the Postural Restoration Institute teach asymmetry and breathing exercises [3].

Wikipedia cites a 2019 meta-analysis that found a correlation between forward head posture and neck pain in adults but not adolescents, and one randomized trial in which thoracic manipulation reduced neck pain immediately [2]. A 1999 in vivo study measured pressures inside lumbar discs during daily postures and activities [4]. No published trial was found testing physiotherapy for the appearance of posture itself.
In the US entry-level education is the Doctor of Physical Therapy; in the UK the title is protected and practitioners register with the Health and Care Professions Council [1].

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, physiotherapy appears in posture discussions as supervised treatment members sometimes stop attending [5].
